end.summary:
Explored “unity in diversity” through music, festivals, food, language, and dress.
Used different instruments making one song to explain many people contributing to one celebration.
Identified shared threads such as joy, new beginnings, sharing food, giving thanks, harvest, and respect.
Gave examples including Diwali, Lohri, Pongal, phiran, Kerala clothing, and different festival forms.
Teach-back was not passed; no recorded misconceptions.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different languages, foods, clothes, festivals, and customs can share common values. The music analogy—different instruments creating one song—helped connect diversity with unity, and they identified shared ideas in Diwali, Lohri, Pongal, and harvest festivals. They also raised the question of groups and disagreements; this was discussed through shared learning, respect, and participation, with no misconception recorded. At home, ask Riya to choose two festivals or regional traditions and name one difference and one shared value.
